page_title: MON 1-2 CAG | Monza v Cagliari 05/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Monza can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+6' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the roof of the net. Simone Scuffet guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The ball goes out for a corner. Monza can continue in their attacking effort.
90+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
90+4' Post! Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
90+3' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Cagliari is cautioned for aggressive play. Monza are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
88' The referee can't ignore those comments and Alessandro Bianco (Monza) sees a yellow card for bad language.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is brought on as a substitute for Nicolas Viola.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Razvan Marin is coming onto the pitch as Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' It will be a substitution. Kevin Martins (Monza) is ready to enter the pitch as Gianluca Caprari walks off.
83' Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
79' Marco Di Bello blows for a foul after Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
78' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
75' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) for Warren Bondo.
75' Substitution. Pedro Pereira did his best and is replaced by Daniel Maldini (Monza).
75' Here is a change. Roberto Piccoli is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).
75' Mattia Felici goes off the pitch and Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) comes on.
74' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
72' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
69' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
67' Problems for Davide Nicola as Yerry Mina is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) replaces him.
67' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
66' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
63' He’s off! Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) gets his marching orders from referee Marco Di Bello after the VAR review.
62' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza)! Let's see what he decides.
61' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle. Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) commits a foul after dangerous play.
61' The Monza players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
58' Luca Caldirola (Monza) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Di Bello blows for a foul.
57' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.

56' 1 - 2 Stunning strike! Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) latches on to a precise through ball from Adam Obert before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the roof of the net from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:2.
55' Salvatore Bocchetti has decided to make a change. Milan Djuric (Monza) replaces Dany Mota.
55' Alessandro Bianco (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Stefano Sensi.
52' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
51' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) brings his opponent down. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Monza win a free kick.
49' Luca Caldirola (Monza) commits a rough foul. Marco Di Bello stops the game and makes a call.
49' OFF THE BAR! Stefano Sensi (Monza) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
47' Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Stefano Turati (Monza) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+1' Stefano Turati (Monza) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Marco Di Bello shows a yellow card to Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.

42' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) finds himself some space around the penalty spot to connect with a fine free kick. His header is slightly mistimed and sails inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
41' Dangerous play by Danilo D'Ambrosio (Monza). Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Cagliari.

40' Warren Bondo (Monza) receives an accurate pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, his effort goes high above the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
36' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Monza are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
33' The referee awards a corner and Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) goes over to take it.
30' Warren Bondo (Monza) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
29' Stefano Sensi (Monza) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Marco Di Bello blows for a foul.
26' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) is adjudged offside.
25' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
22' 1 - 1 Goal! Mattia Felici plays a short, square pass into the path of Nadir Zortea (Cagliari), who bends a shot straight into the left side of the goal to make it 1:1. Fabulous goal!
21' Adam Obert (Cagliari) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
19' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
18' Stefano Sensi (Monza) was too forceful with his tackle and Marco Di Bello interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
15' Close! Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.
13' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

12' Cagliari seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities. Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 26:74.
10' Yerry Mina (Cagliari) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
10' The free kick from long range, taken by Cagliari, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monza.
9' The referee blows his whistle as Gianluca Caprari (Monza) was too aggressive in his challenge. Free kick. Cagliari will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
8' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
8' Marco Di Bello interrupts the game. One of the players from Monza won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Cagliari have a free kick.
6' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Gianluca Caprari (Monza) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Simone Scuffet no chance!
5' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) is going to take the penalty!
5' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Monza!

4' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Monza.
3' That looked a certain handball by Antoine Makoumbou (Cagliari) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
2' Mattia Felici (Cagliari) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance.
2' There's an opportunity for Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
2' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Monza will take the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to minute of silence.
Marco Di Bello will officiate today.
